description: This file contains utility functions for managing Git notes, including creating commits, parsing merge strategies, handling configuration, and rewriting notes. It interacts with Git's internal structures to manipulate notes in a repository.

methods.name: void create_notes_commit(struct repository * r,struct notes_tree * t,const struct commit_list * parents,const char * msg,size_t msg_len,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Creates a new commit object for notes, either deriving a parent from the reference or using provided parents, and writes the notes tree to the database.

methods.name: void commit_notes(struct repository * r,struct notes_tree * t,const char * msg)
methods.description: Creates and commits a notes tree update with a specified message and updates the corresponding reference.

methods.name: int parse_notes_merge_strategy(const char * v,enum notes_merge_strategy * s)
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the notes merge strategy enum value.

methods.name: combine_notes_fn parse_combine_notes_fn(const char * v)
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the notes combining function.

methods.name: int notes_rewrite_config(const char * k,const char * v,const struct config_context * ctx UNUSED,void * cb)
methods.description: Processes configuration settings related to notes rewriting, updating the notes_rewrite_cfg structure accordingly.

methods.name: struct:notes_rewrite_cfg * init_copy_notes_for_rewrite(const char * cmd)
methods.description: Initializes a notes rewrite configuration struct based on environment variables and repository config.

methods.name: int copy_note_for_rewrite(struct notes_rewrite_cfg * c,const struct object_id * from_obj,const struct object_id * to_obj)
methods.description: Copies notes from one object to another for all configured note trees.

methods.name: void finish_copy_notes_for_rewrite(struct repository * r,struct notes_rewrite_cfg * c,const char * msg)
methods.description: Finalizes the notes rewrite process by committing notes and freeing resources.

ctags.name: commit_notes
ctags.pattern: /^void commit_notes(struct repository *r, struct notes_tree *t, const char *msg)$/
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct notes_tree * t,const char * msg)

ctags.name: copy_note_for_rewrite
ctags.signature: (struct notes_rewrite_cfg * c,const struct object_id * from_obj,const struct object_id * to_obj)

ctags.name: create_notes_commit
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct notes_tree * t,const struct commit_list * parents,const char * msg,size_t msg_len,struct object_id * result_oid)

ctags.name: finish_copy_notes_for_rewrite
ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct notes_rewrite_cfg * c,const char * msg)

ctags.name: notes_rewrite_config
ctags.signature: (const char * k,const char * v,const struct config_context * ctx UNUSED,void * cb)
